name: New York City UV-5R channel plan, written 2026-10-17
notes: Researched 2026-10-17 for Manhattan within 40 km. Channels 3 to 7 need an amateur license to transmit; channels 8 and 9 need a GMRS license. Channels 10 to 14 are receive only. Use channel 3 first to call for help, then channel 4. Unverified: NOAA HD reception inside Manhattan; BX550 frequency comes from the myGMRS listing name and its tone sits behind a login, so it stays receive only until the tone is confirmed; local repeaters on 462.675 may use a tone other than 141.3; the BEARS Skywarn net time; channel 14 comes from general knowledge.
